## Outcome and scope

Describe the problem, affected skills/policies, and intended behavior. Use synthetic examples only.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests and package verifier pass; skipped validators are explicitly listed.
- [ ] Skill/policy changes update registry hashes and appropriate versions.
- [ ] Upstream licensing and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES remain valid.
- [ ] Reviewed output/diff for secrets, customer data and private paths.
- [ ] Codex and Claude pilot results or an explicit not-tested note included.
- [ ] Owner review requested; changelog and migration/rollback notes included.

## Risk and rollback

Explain limits, compatibility and how to return to the prior approved release.
Do not attach private prompts, raw logs, credentials or production data.
